questions.q: For how long does the article say Islam and Hinduism have coexisted?
options: Both are described as great traditions living side by side.
The article says more than a thousand.
The article says more than a thousand years.
The article says more than a thousand.
questions.rationale: Islam and Hinduism both representing two great traditions, have coexisted for more than one thousand years.

questions.q: What did the angels ask when God said He would create a successor on earth?
options: Whether they could go to earth too
Whether man would live for ever
Whether He would place there one who would cause corruption and shed blood
God answered, ‘I know that which you do not know.’
questions.rationale: ‘Will You place someone there who will cause corruption on it and shed blood, while we glorify You with Your praise?’

questions.q: What has taken the position of arbiter since the rise of modern science?
options: Religion was the arbiter only in the earlier phase.
Though it is neither for nor against religion.
questions.rationale: Now it is science—without itself being either for or against religion—that has acquired the position of arbiter.

questions.q: What can a negative personality lead to, according to the article?
options: Negative thinking produces a negative personality.
The article calls it psychological suicide.
questions.rationale: Negative thinking produces a negative personality, which can lead to psychological suicide.

questions.q: Why do most intelligent people shy away from devoting themselves to religion?
options: The reason given is immediate gain.
The reason given is immediate gain.
“Truly, you love immediate gain and neglect the Hereafter.”
The reason given is immediate gain.
questions.rationale: What is the reason for this? It is the attraction of immediate gain.

questions.q: What does the article say is found between a man and a woman as in no other created pair?
options: The article speaks of compatibility, not sameness.
All things are created in pairs, but this compatibility is unique.
questions.rationale: The compatibility that exists between a man and a woman cannot be found in any other created thing.

questions.q: Which historian theorised that a creative minority plays the revolutionary role in any society?
options: In his book Study of History.
questions.rationale: Arnold Toynbee, in his famous book Study of History theorises that it is always the creative minority that plays a revolutionary role.

The article says they become unscientific.
This is not what the article says.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijrah did the Prophet leave Medina for Makkah to perform the pilgrimage?
options: The verses (48: 1–3) speak of a clear victory.
questions.rationale: In the sixth year of the Hijrah, the Prophet Muhammad left Medina for Makkah along with his companions.
